score_definition.argmax_note: temperature and uniform support mixture preserve argmax; ties use the smallest action index

advantage_definition.raw_gae: existing PPO _gae over the 8 locked validation episodes; gamma=0.99, lambda=0.95
advantage_definition.sign_used: float32 z-score normalization over the 212 validation rows, matching the policy-loss sign convention
advantage_definition.attribution_limit: only the observed behavior action has an empirical GAE advantage; a changed unobserved action is recorded as unlabeled_counterfactual_direction

decision_rule_operationalization.useful_2_to_4x: at either 2x or 4x, pooled labeled positive changes exceed pooled labeled negative changes and positive count is nonzero
decision_rule_operationalization.harmful_2_to_4x: at either 2x or 4x, pooled labeled negative changes exceed pooled labeled positive changes
decision_rule_operationalization.almost_no_change_8x: pooled 8x argmax changes are at most 5% of 636 checkpoint-position comparisons
decision_rule_operationalization.baseline_margin_expanded: at least one independent checkpoint has more expanded-margin positions than shrunk-margin positions
